svg.title: Causal mask with query-aware contextualization
svg.desc: A 7 by 7 attention mask for instruction, question copy 1, documents 1 to 3, question copy 2 and answer. The document rows can see the first question copy.
svg.text: The question is placed before AND after the documents. The causal mask is the same rule, but now it helps.
Green box: documents now see the question
Q1, a copy of the question, comes before
the documents. Every document row can
attend to it, so each document is read
The second copy, Q2, is still after
the documents. It stays in its usual
